svg.title: Misty Embodied Agent: attention and a bounded ReAct episode
svg.desc: (a) A continuous stream of audio and camera frames passes through a voice gate and a visual gate, which form cues; cues wait in a queue ordered by priority and the selected cue's Trigger Evidence e opens an episode. (b) Three blocks form the loop. The LLM policy pi, which reads Skills on demand, chooses one action a_t per turn, stated as intent; a safety controller under the action sets speed and duration. The observation o_t, carrying a Snapshot of distance, face in view and new speech, returns to the policy, for at most T turns (the configured turn cap). Under each block, a frame from the demo: the supportive-interaction Skill being loaded, Misty asking what kind of company the person wants, and the person answering "Just stay with me quietly".
